name: Short Cut Baked Fish Tacos with Cilantro-Lime Cabbage Slaw, Avocado & Hot Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F and place rack in the center position. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Once the oven is heated, transfer fish sticks to the baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven and bake until starting to brown, about 7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (680 g) bag frozen breaded fish sticks

instructions.primary_message: Remove baking sheet from oven and turn the fish sticks. Return to the oven and continue baking until golden, crispy, and cooked through, 7 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place shredded cabbage and dressing in a medium bowl. Toss to combine the slaw and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (397 g) bag shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
⅔ cup creamy cilantro lime dressing

instructions.primary_message: About 5 minutes before the fish sticks are done, place tortillas, stacked one on top of another, in the center of a large square of aluminum foil. Pull the edges of the foil up around the tortillas to close. Add tortillas to the oven and bake until warmed through, 3-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and quarter lime.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Divide warm tortillas between plates. Fill each tortilla with slaw, 3-4 fish sticks, and avocado. Drizzle with hot sauce and serve with lime for squeezing. Enjoy!
